title: 4 Keys Keyboard
goal: Maximize the number of A characters produced by n presses on a four-key keyboard.
strategy: Either type directly or finish with Select All, Copy, and several Pastes. Try every earlier breakpoint whose best screen count is copied; multiply it by the number of final copies.
